public.name: LowEnergy.GaussComposite.ActualDressedStaticFeedback.actual_corrected_static_feedback
public.source_signature:
theorem actual_corrected_static_feedback (event : DressedEvent) (n : PhysicalMomentum)
    (unit : spatialSquare n=1) (kappa : staticDomain) (sigma : ℝ) (positive : 0<sigma)
    (regular : correctedDet event (Real.sqrt kappa.val) 0 sigma n≠0) (forcing : Fin 289→ℂ) :
    correctedResponse event (Real.sqrt kappa.val) 0 sigma n forcing=
      sourceGreen (sourceSpatialStaticRegularPoint n unit kappa)*ᵥforcing+
      sourceGreen (sourceSpatialStaticRegularPoint n unit kappa)*ᵥ
        (frequencyQuantumCorrection event (kappa.val • n) (sourceStaticSpatialMomentum n kappa.val)
          (dampedFourierClock 0 sigma)*ᵥcorrectedResponse event (Real.sqrt kappa.val) 0 sigma n forcing)+
      sourceNullLift (sourceStaticSpatialMomentum n kappa.val)
        (sourceNullCoordinates (sourceStaticSpatialMomentum n kappa.val)
          (correctedResponse event (Real.sqrt kappa.val) 0 sigma n forcing))

    (unit : spatialSquare n=1) (pd ps : PhysicalMomentum) (dL dR sL sR : CompositeLeg)
    (nonzero : irClockDeterminant event n≠0)
    (factor : Polynomial.X^sourceClockOrder event n∣irClockProbeNumerator event n pd ps dL dR sL sR) :

public.name: LowEnergy.GaussComposite.ActualDressedStaticFeedback.SourceLongrangeReturn
public.source_signature:
structure SourceLongrangeReturn (event : DressedEvent) (n : PhysicalMomentum) (unit : spatialSquare n=1)
    (pd ps : PhysicalMomentum) (dL dR sL sR : CompositeLeg) where
  branch : OrderedStaticReturn event n pd ps dL dR sL sR
  actualReturn : match branch with
    | .finite _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
      (∀ᶠ kappa : staticDomain in staticApproach,
        Tendsto (fun sigma : ℝ => feedbackCurrentRead event n unit kappa sigma pd ps dL dR sL sR+
            nullCurrentRead event n kappa sigma pd ps dL dR sL sR)
          (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (zeroFeedbackNullRead event n unit kappa pd ps dL dR sL sR))) ∧
        Tendsto (fun kappa : staticDomain => -(kappa.val : ℂ)^2*zeroFeedbackNullRead event n unit kappa pd ps dL dR sL sR)
          staticApproach (𝓝 (sourceFeedbackNullCoefficient event n pd ps dL dR sL sR))
    | _ => True
